summary: Iteration 257: Tested Twilio Number Pool feature - User Termination flow. 14/14 backend tests passed. Frontend verified for deactivation dialog and pool number labels. Found 1 critical bug: PUT /reactivate endpoint missing pooled_number_available in response.

critical.issue: Response does NOT include 'pooled_number_available' field. Frontend at [id].tsx line 304 reads 'res.data?.pooled_number_available' from the PUT response, but PUT endpoint (lines 559-619 in admin_users.py) only returns {message, user_id, user_name}. The POST reactivate endpoint (line 858) correctly returns pooled_number_available, but frontend uses PUT. As a result, the toast note 'Their old number (X) is still in the pool' NEVER appears.
critical.fix: Add pool number check to PUT reactivate endpoint: after reactivating, query phone_number_pool for {previous_user_id: user_id, status: 'pool'} and include pooled_number_available in response

integration_issues.issue: Toast 'Their old number (X) is still in the pool' never shows because PUT /reactivate doesn't return pooled_number_available

pool_endpoint.verification: Returns 200 with {pool: [], count: 0} structure. Verified with mock entries.

delete_releases_number.verification: number_released_to_pool field present in response with correct phone number. User's twilio_number/mvpline_number unset. phone_number_pool entry updated to status='pool' with previous_user_name, previous_user_id, released_at.

reactivate_pooled_number.status: PARTIAL - POST works, PUT does not
reactivate_pooled_number.endpoint_put: PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id}/reactivate - FAIL: does NOT return pooled_number_available
reactivate_pooled_number.frontend_uses: PUT (line 302 of [id].tsx) - so pool note toast never shows

numbers_list_previous_owner.verification: Returns numbers list with previous_owner.name and released_at for pool numbers that have DB entries

webhook_routing.verification: twilio_webhooks.py lines 122-145: Checks phone_number_pool for terminated rep numbers, routes to store manager if previous_store_id exists, falls back to super_admin

frontend_deactivation_dialog.verification: Dialog shows: 'Their dedicated number (+14352203414) will be held in the Number Pool for reassignment to a new rep.' for users with twilio_number

frontend_previously_label.verification: Pool numbers show 'Previously: TEST Jane Doe (released Just now)' label when previous_owner.name present in API response

action_items: Fix PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id}/reactivate (admin_users.py lines 559-619) to also return pooled_number_available field. Query: phone_number_pool.find_one({previous_user_id: user_id, status: 'pool'}). Return pooled_number_available: pool_entry['phone_number'] if found.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_users.py line 559: PUT reactivate endpoint lacks pooled_number_available in response, even though frontend reads it. Easy fix: add 5-line pool check before return statement (same logic as POST reactivate lines 912-922).
Two separate reactivate endpoints (PUT and POST) with different logic creates maintenance confusion. Consider consolidating or ensuring both have feature parity.

pool_entry lookup in GET /admin/twilio/numbers at line 77-78 only fetches if user is None, which is correct - but there's no index on phone_number_pool.phone_number collection which could be slow at scale.

success_rate.backend: 93% - 14/14 pytest tests passed; 1 behavioral bug in PUT reactivate
success_rate.frontend: 85% - Deactivation dialog PASS, Previously label PASS; Pool toast note broken due to backend PUT issue

seed_data_creation: Created/deleted test users and pool entries during testing. All cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 257 tested Twilio Number Pool feature. All core flows work EXCEPT: PUT /api/admin/users/{id}/reactivate does not return pooled_number_available (only POST does). Fix: add pool check to PUT endpoint in admin_users.py around line 614, same as POST endpoint lines 912-922. After fix, verify that reactivating a user whose number is in the pool shows the toast note with the pool number. Phone numbers page 'Previously:' label works. Deactivation dialog works. Pool endpoint works. Number release on deactivation works.

rca_of_issue.root_cause: Two separate reactivate endpoints were created (PUT at line 559 for simple reactivation, POST at line 858 for contact restoration reactivation). The new pool feature (pooled_number_available) was only added to the POST endpoint but not the PUT endpoint. The frontend was updated to read pooled_number_available from PUT response but the endpoint was never updated.
rca_of_issue.reproduction: 1. Create user, add mvpline_number to DB, deactivate via DELETE. 2. Call PUT /api/admin/users/{id}/reactivate - response will be {message, user_id, user_name} - no pooled_number_available field. 3. Frontend toast note never shows.
rca_of_issue.fix: In admin_users.py PUT reactivate (lines 559-619), before the return statement at line 615, add: pool_entry = await db.phone_number_pool.find_one({'previous_user_id': user_id, 'status': 'pool'}); pooled_number = pool_entry['phone_number'] if pool_entry else None. Then add 'pooled_number_available': pooled_number to the return dict.
